verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs describe source-available prebuilt triggers and actions for thousands of apps, with one-click OAuth and key-based auth for more than 3,000 APIs. The llms.txt probe puts the catalog at 3,223 apps, and community users say it saves them building integration steps by hand. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the integrations are vendor-maintained (the docs note components can be contributed via GitHub PRs), independent hands-on corroboration of connector breadth and quality

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for more than 3,000 APIs (use tokens directly in code or with pre-built actions)
you can use pre-built components when you're performing common actions
Pipedream Connect provides managed auth, MCP servers, and API tooling for 3,223
